description: Toggle a killswitch or one of its switches. Flips a killswitch on one environment and publishes a new version there. This is the one-call incident verb: it reads the current value, flips it, and publishes, so you don't have to fetch the killswitch first.

anyOf.description: Target environment. One of the project's configured envs (`dev`, `staging`, `prod`).

env.description: Environment to publish on. Defaults to `prod` — the environment an incident response means when it says "kill it".

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

switchKey.description: Which target to flip. Omit (or `null`) to flip the killswitch's own flat `value`; name a switch key to flip that nested sub-switch instead, creating the entry if it doesn't exist yet.

value.description: The value to publish. Omit (or `null`) to flip whatever is stored now — read-modify-write in one call. Pass an explicit `true`/`false` to make the call idempotent, so a retry can't undo the first attempt.

name: release_killswitch_toggle
